en.headline: Chiu Hin-chun wins Hong Kong’s fourth Asian Games gold in rowing
en.dek: The veteran sculler took the men’s lightweight single sculls in 6:50.32 in Nagoya, completing a set of gold, silver and bronze across three Games.
body: Chiu Hin-chun won the men’s lightweight single sculls at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Thursday, giving Hong Kong its fourth gold of the campaign and his first title in three appearances at the Games.

The Education University of Hong Kong master’s student finished in 6 minutes 50.32 seconds, more than two seconds ahead of Iran’s Amirhossein Mahmoodpour Shahrestani. South Korea took bronze. Chiu sat second through the first 1,000 metres before moving clear over the second half of the course.

Chiu, in his thirties, won silver in the same lightweight event at Jakarta in 2018 and bronze in the open single sculls at Hangzhou in 2023. He said afterwards he was excited and thanked supporters after hearing Cantonese calls from the coaching team along the course.

Hong Kong’s rowing squad had a strong day on the Nagaragawa course, adding silver medals for Hong Wing-yan in the women’s lightweight single and for Cheung Yuen-shan and Leung Wing-on in the women’s lightweight double, plus bronze for Lam Sun-tung and Chan Dik-lun in the men’s lightweight double. Culture, Sports and Tourism Secretary Rosanna Law said Thursday was Hong Kong’s most decorated day of the Games so far, lifting the team to four golds, 10 silvers and nine bronzes.

zh.headline: 趙顯臻輕量級單人雙樺封王 港隊亞運添第四金
zh.dek: 港隊賽艇代表趙顯臻在名古屋以6分50秒32奪得男子輕量級單人雙樺金牌，三戰亞運集齊金銀銅，亦是港隊今屆第四金。
body: 港隊賽艇選手趙顯臻周四在愛知名古屋亞運男子輕量級單人雙樺決賽奪金，為中國香港代表團添上今屆第四金，亦是他三屆亞運以來首面金牌。
現於香港教育大學修讀碩士課程的趙顯臻以6分50秒32衝線，領先伊朗選手超過兩秒，銅牌由韓國選手獲得。他在首1000米處於第二，後半程發力超前並保持領先至終點。
三十多歲的趙顯臻2018年雅加達亞運在同一輕量級項目奪銀，2023年杭州亞運則在公開組單人雙樺取銅。他賽後表示興奮並多謝支持者，又指在賽道旁聽到總教練以廣東話打氣。
港隊賽艇當日在長良川賽道收穫頗豐，洪詠甄奪女子輕量級單人雙樺銀牌，張荼珊與梁穎桉奪女子輕量級雙人雙樺銀牌，林新棟與陳廼麟則在男子輕量級雙人雙樺取銅。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，周四是港隊開幕至今單日獎牌最多的一天，代表團累積4金、10銀、9銅。
